body:
Hi @jeroenhuinink 👋🏻 

Thanks for reporting this 🙇🏻 

I've just given it a try, and I'm unable to reproduce. It doesn't mean there is no bug, but it might not strictly be related to resolving imports, and, based on the module resolution error, rather about native extensions support.

Does any of your test rely on an extension (xk6-*) by any chance?

If so, would you be able to provide us an anonymized expanded example that illustrates the issue?

Bringing @pablochacin into this conversation too as he has been handling most of the module/extension resolution in k6; any hunch on this?

Hi @jeroenhuinink, I'm unable to reproduce the error.  

I'm assuming that this code is the content of `2/lib.ts`, right?

```ts
export function lib() {
    console.log('lib');
}
```

Following your instructions, I get this result:
```
INFO[0000] lib                                           source=console
INFO[0000] test                                          source=console
```

I still can not reproduce this. 

I have created a repo https://github.com/mstoykov/k6-issue-5176 - can you please check it out and test that this oversimplified example works for you? And if it does, can you try to make it not work in v1.3.0?

Thank you for your time 🙇

issue.title: Fix auto extension resolution breaking tests on windows

repository.name: k6
repository.description: A modern load testing tool, using Go and JavaScript

issue.body:
## What?

On Windows due to a mistake in #5016 on windows loading files would not work during the auto extension resolution in some cases and that breaks running the test as a whole.

## Why?
This should be working.
